## User-visible changes

- A GPU runtime is checked in Section 1; nothing is installed into the kernel; the first Run all builds an isolated environment (about 9 GB). The learner cells are short `run_stage(...)` calls.
- New fields: `GROUP_SEPARATOR`, `SEED` (Section 4), `EPOCHS`, `LEARNING_RATE` (Section 7), `RUN_ACTIVITY`, `ACTIVITY_LEARNING_RATE` (new Section 11). The old `BYOD_ZIP_PATH` keeps its meaning.
- The baseline and evaluation print both prompt conditions and every held-out record; the evaluation report adds `conditions`, `interpretation`, `computed_by` and the weights-moved-versus-quality-changed note.
- The held-out evaluation and the unseen inference use the exported adapter on a fresh base in fresh processes.

## Verification

All offline; none of it is clean-runtime or pretrained-model evidence.

- Local command set in a Python 3.12 venv with `numpy` 2.5.3, `pillow` 11.3.0, `pytest`, `ruff` and the package `--no-deps`: `ruff check src tests tools` clean; pytest 32 → 53 passed, excluding `tests/test_adaptation.py`, which imports torch (the CPU-torch index CI uses is blocked here; that file and `pipeline.py` are unchanged and CI runs it); `tools/validate_release_assets.py` and `tools/build_notebook.py --check` pass.
- **Offline probe** (the notebook's own cells exec'd in order with a stand-in `nvidia-smi`; the install cell's venv replaced by a local CPython 3.12 interpreter; the real package for staging, dataset validation, `evaluate_adaptation`, `segment` and `mask_iou`; `model.safetensors` a dummy and the model, `finetune`, `save_artifact` and `load_artifact` replaced by a numpy stand-in): a CPU-only runtime stops in Section 1; every default stage completes; the real data path reproduces the recorded prompt-box fill baseline (0.856681); both conditions and the per-record rows print, with the interpretation lines; the fresh-base reload check passes; re-running Section 1 then Section 9 works; the activity writes only to `outputs/activity/`. BYOD: a wrapped, grouped 15-pair ZIP by path completes (5 groups, 6 held out, the unseen check on a held-out BYOD record); a JPEG mask, five pairs, an empty path outside Colab and a cancelled upload stop with named messages.

## Remaining gates

1. A hosted one-pass **Run all** of the regenerated blob on a Colab T4 (SAM-S2), recorded with `restarted: false`, versions, both prompt conditions per record, and the reload check (this also confirms the real model path, which the probe replaced).
2. The REL12 BYOD journey: one compatible and one incompatible ZIP.
3. Maintainer (SAM-M2): decide whether to make the default task harder (textured backgrounds, low contrast, occlusion, loose boxes) or keep it as an explicitly labelled mechanics check with the point-only condition; update the release records for the new blob.
